K1.name: Recirculating-power chain (ignition and driver)
K1.story: Better targets and drivers lower the recirculating power, which lowers warm-loop heat and driver mass, which lowers the mass the drive must push. Gain does not lower the fusion power needed for a given thrust; fusion power falls only because the lighter ship needs less thrust at the same acceleration.

singles.mechanism: magnetised fuel-only targets double target gain (3,000 to 6,000): driver power 1/(G eta_d) halves
heavy-ion driver wall-plug 0.30 (published) to 0.45 (FDP-1 optimistic): less driver loss heat
driver hardware 0.05 to 0.025 kg/kW (lighter induction cores, higher gradient)
target factory and controls 0.05 % to 0.025 % of fusion

K2.name: Thermal chain (hot machinery and light radiators)
K2.story: Hotter machinery and lighter radiator surfaces shrink the wings; smaller wings shrink spars, view-factor penalties and the dust-exposed edge.

singles.mechanism: warm loop 700 to 800 K: MW power electronics at 800 K, cores near the FINEMET limit
liquid-sheet or droplet surfaces for the warm field: 1.0 to 0.5 kg/m2
thin-wall refractory heat pipes (Mo-Re / C-C) for the 1,800 K band: 3.0 to 1.5 kg/m2

K3.name: Nozzle chain (collimation and recovery)
K3.story: A validated 3D nozzle field raises efficiency and lowers the plume share that strikes hardware; pulse-to-pulse control keeps burns centred so the design efficiency holds. Recovery and nozzle efficiency draw on the same expanding plasma.

singles.mechanism: nozzle efficiency 0.79 to 0.86 (top of the MSFC theoretical range); the sign of the helical effect is unresolved (D-09)
shaped field halves the plume share striking hardware (2 % to 1 % of the nozzle loss)

K4.name: Compression chain (small pulses, small nozzle)
K4.story: Denser compression gives the same burn fraction from a smaller pellet: smaller yield per pulse, a closer X-ray stand-off, loops of half the radius, a smaller shield and less dust-exposed loop area, paid for by a higher pulse rate.

singles.mechanism: compressed fuel density 3,000 to 6,000 g/cm3 (pellet mass /4 at the same rhoR); rate rises about 3.4x
advanced W armour (MAT-W-ADV01) at half areal mass

K5.name: Structure chain (strength per mass)
K5.story: The nozzle structure obeys the virial bound M >= rho W / sigma; only a stronger-per-mass material lowers it. Lighter spars and frames follow from the same material class.

singles.mechanism: hoop structure at twice the specific strength of 1.5 GPa CFRP (3 GPa at 1.6 t/m3): virial mass halves

basis_note: FDP-1 fdp1-v1 optimistic tier via convergence.py; base V1c = Atlas V1 at driver efficiency 0.30

downside.what: m = 4 ripple costs 0.07 of nozzle efficiency
warm loop held at the 600 K core limit
house load at the unsourced FDP-1 0.1 %

ve_gate.note: With burn fraction capped at 0.999 and about 1.2 % of fusion escaping as radiation, the lowest nozzle efficiency that can reach the mission ve is about gate / 0.988; the Atlas bisection (0.40-0.86, 9 steps) lands at 0.528 for every generation because it hits this gate, which no mass or thermal improvement moves.

consistency.source: T04 EARLY 1b85941 section 1 (bound); T01 EARLY 57fe625 (628 K, 0.005 %)
